ui.lab_title: Follow the evidence. Understand the decision.
ui.lab_intro: Explore five recorded investigations. See how each check changes the risk score, where policy intervenes, and why missing evidence matters.
ui.lab_choose_hint: Select a case, then replay the evidence one step at a time.
ui.lab_risk_note: Policy-derived score, not a calibrated fraud probability. Points come from recorded evidence.
ui.lab_case_sim: A new SIM. The same customer.
ui.planner_scope: Applies to your next investigation. Lab recordings stay unchanged.
ui.planner_key_needed: Save a Gemini key to enable LLM mode.
ui.key_scope: One key for Checkout, Console, and Lab model runs in this browser tab. Viewing recordings does not call Gemini.
ui.key_privacy: Stored in this tab’s session storage. Sent to this app’s server for model requests, then to Google. The app does not write it to its database, receipts, or logs. Calls use your saved key’s quota, or the site key when none is saved.
ui.key_get: Get a key from Google AI Studio
ui.key_invalid: Enter a key without spaces, up to 200 characters.
ui.key_storage_error: Could not save the key. Allow session storage and try again.
ui.key_next: Ready for your next investigation. The trace will show model selections or errors.
ui.key_forget_error: Could not remove the saved key. Clear this site’s session storage.
ui.key_forgotten: Key removed. Requests already in progress may finish.
ui.key_disabled: Personal keys are disabled on this deployment.
ui.key_unavailable: Could not check key support. Reload to try again.
ui.ak_title: Call the API the way a merchant would
ui.ak_sub: Mint a merchant key behind the organizer's access code, then send the judge guide's /v1/verify request to this deployment instead of to a local server.
ui.ak_h_facts: What a key from this page does
ui.ak_v_tenant: your own. Chains you create from a terminal are readable back from this tab, and from no other judge's.
ui.ak_v_where: in this process's memory only. A restart of the deployment forgets every key; mint another.
ui.ak_provider_mock: mock · Nokia-compatible demo. Nothing is sent to Nokia.
ui.ak_planner_llm: Gemini · LLM. Add the X-Isnad-Planner: greedy header (already in the commands below) to reproduce the guide’s numbers.
ui.ak_planner_greedy: greedy · deterministic. Results match the guide as written.
ui.ak_unavailable: This deployment does not issue keys from a page: its default provider makes billable calls. Use a configured merchant key.
ui.ak_code_note: The code is checked by the server and never stored. It is the same code that unlocks Real NaC on the checkout page; mock evidence there needs no code at all.
ui.ak_minted: Key issued. It is shown once, below.
ui.ak_session_failed: Could not start a judge session:
ui.ak_key_once: Shown once. Copy it now; reloading this page will not show it again.
ui.ak_try_intro: Three commands, in order. Each is filled in with your key and this deployment's address. The first one is the judge guide's step 6, sent here instead of to a local server; the planner header pins the deterministic planner so the numbers match the guide.
ui.ak_expect_verify: Expect "decision": "CHALLENGE", "chain_grade": "DEGRADED", "confidence": 0.322 and a chain of five links, each naming its API, result, source and consent basis. Note the chain_id.
ui.ak_expect_chain: Replace CHAIN_ID with the value from step 1. Expect the same verdict; reads are scoped to the key's tenant, so another judge's chain_id returns 404.
ui.ak_expect_signature: Expect "valid": true. The receipt page does the same check in the browser and lets you flip one byte to watch it fail.
ui.ak_idempotency: Run step 1 twice with the same Idempotency-Key and the second answer replays the first, same chain_id, without a second investigation. Change the amount and keep the key: 409.
ui.ak_not_nokia: A key to Nokia. On this deployment the merchant API runs against the Nokia-compatible mock, so a call with this key sends nothing to an operator. Real Nokia calls are made only from the checkout page's bounded Real NaC path, which the same access code unlocks.
ui.ak_not_prod: A production credential. It lives for a fixed time in memory and is minted from a web page; a deployment whose default provider bills refuses to issue one at all.
ui.ak_not_shared: Shared. Each key belongs to the tab that minted it. Two judges holding keys from this page cannot read each other's chains, receipts or journals.
ui.risk_score_note: Policy-derived, uncalibrated score. It is not a measured fraud probability.
ui.swap_date_available: Operator reported the latest change at
ui.swap_date_age: Age at the moment of the check
ui.swap_date_no_date: The operator answered with no date. This is not evidence that no change ever happened.
ui.swap_date_unsupported: This provider has no date operation for this check.
ui.swap_date_denied: The operator declined the date request.
ui.swap_date_timeout: The date request timed out. The check itself is unaffected.
ui.swap_date_invalid: The returned date could not be read as a real event time.
ui.swap_date_not_attempted: The remaining budget did not cover the extra date call.
ui.swap_date_may_be_activation: “Latest change” can mean an activation or a first association, not a replacement.
ui.swap_date_horizon_unknown: How far back the operator looked is unknown.
ui.swap_date_disagrees: The operator's own two answers disagree: the check says a change inside the window, the date is outside it.
ui.swap_date_agrees: The date falls inside the window the check asked about.
ui.swap_date_separate_call: A separate, separately priced operator call.
ui.network_conditions_scope: Information about the network, shown separately from the trust decision. A congested cell can explain a slow or failed verification. It is not evidence about a person, it never changes the risk score, and it never waives a check.
ui.network_conditions_idle: No subscription. Nothing is requested from the operator until you ask.
ui.network_conditions_failed: The request did not complete. Your order and this page are unchanged.
ui.network_conditions_empty: The operator returned no reading. The condition is unknown.
ui.signal_AT_CLAIMED_LOCATION: The device is at the claimed location.
ui.signal_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Number verification needs the customer's consent.
ui.signal_DEVICE_STABLE: No device change inside the window the check asked about.
ui.signal_DEVICE_SWAPPED: A device change inside the window the check asked about.
ui.signal_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: The operator could not produce evidence for this device.
ui.signal_HOME_NETWORK: The device is on its home network.
ui.signal_LOCATION_PARTIAL: The device partially overlaps the claimed area.
ui.signal_NOT_AT_CLAIMED_LOCATION: The device is not at the claimed location.
ui.signal_NUMBER_CONTINUOUS: No subscriber change since the merchant last verified this number.
ui.signal_NUMBER_MATCH: The network's number matches the number provided.
ui.signal_NUMBER_MISMATCH: The network's number does not match the number provided.
ui.signal_NUMBER_RECYCLED: The subscriber behind this number changed since the merchant last verified it.
ui.signal_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The operator request did not complete.
ui.signal_REACHABLE_NORMAL: The device is reachable on the network.
ui.signal_REACHABLE_UNAVAILABLE: The device is not reachable from the network.
ui.signal_RECYCLING_REFERENCE_INVALID: The merchant's last-verified date is not one the operator can answer about.
ui.signal_RECYCLING_REFERENCE_MISSING: The merchant holds no last-verified date for this number.
ui.signal_SIM_STABLE: No SIM change inside the window the check asked about.
ui.signal_SIM_SWAPPED: A SIM change inside the window the check asked about.
ui.machine_prose_note: shown as the agent wrote it
ui.next_action_ALLOW: No further action needed. You may proceed with this order.
ui.next_action_CHALLENGE: Ask the customer to complete your own additional verification step, such as a callback or manual review, before proceeding. Isnad has not sent the customer a one-time code: this decision means more evidence is needed, not that a code is waiting to be entered.
ui.next_action_DECLINE: Do not proceed with this order without independent manual review.
ui.demo_settings: Demo settings — planner and your own Gemini key

ui.es_real_explain: Actual requests to Nokia's hosted simulator using test numbers.
ui.es_applies_next: Applies to the next run. The result below keeps the source it was produced with.
ui.custom_mock_note: Authored teaching fixtures, not Nokia contracts. They have no Nokia simulator scenario and are available in mock only.
ui.es_status_authorized: Real NaC configured and authorized for this session · Nokia connection not yet verified
ui.es_status_needs_code: Real NaC configured · access code required · Nokia connection not yet verified
ui.es_status_disabled: Real NaC is not enabled on this deployment. Mock evidence is unaffected.
ui.es_status_unavailable: Evidence source options unavailable. Reload to try again.
ui.es_access_unlocked: Real NaC unlocked for this session.
ui.es_result_real: This result: actual requests to Nokia’s hosted simulator
ui.es_result_mock: This result: Nokia-compatible responses answered locally · no requests were sent to Nokia
ui.es_wire_synthetic: status and timing below are synthetic, not a measured Nokia latency
ui.es_wire_none: No outbound attempt was made for this run.
ui.es_running_real: Sending actual requests to Nokia’s hosted simulator…
ui.es_running_mock: Running the Nokia-compatible contract locally. No requests are sent to Nokia.
ui.es_failed_real: The real Nokia run did not complete:
ui.es_failed_mock: The mock run did not complete:
ui.es_failed_real_retry: You can choose Mock and run again; that creates a separate run with its own receipt.
ui.review_next: The merchant opens a manual review and records its result. Isnad has not performed that review and has not contacted the customer.
ui.review_effect: Recording a result does not change the signed decision above. It is a separate, separately recorded fact: the original verdict, its signature and its receipt stay exactly as issued.
ui.review_pending: Review open and awaiting a result
ui.review_failed_to_open: The review could not be opened:
